add.title: Add Food
add.subtitle: Search a product, estimate with AI, or enter macros manually. New meals are saved and logged to today.
add.editSubtitle: Update this saved meal. Changes apply the next time you add it to a day.
add.createSuccess: Meal saved and added to today

ai.disclaimer: AI calorie results are an estimate only — not medical advice. Review and edit before saving.
ai.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. bowl of oatmeal with banana and honey
ai.applied: Estimate applied ({calories} kcal + macros). Review and edit before saving.

errors.unauthorized: Sign in again to use AI analysis.
errors.cooldown: Wait about 20 seconds before another analysis.
errors.rateLimited: AI limit reached for now. Wait a bit and try again.
errors.dailyLimit: Daily AI limit reached. Use Search or Manual instead.
errors.invalidDescription: Enter a short food description first.
errors.invalidImage: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP photo under 5 MB.
errors.imageTooLarge: Photo is still too large after compression. Try another image.
errors.unavailable: AI analysis is unavailable. Enter calories manually.
errors.misconfigured: AI is not configured on the server yet.
errors.modelUnavailable: No Gemini model is available for this API key. Set GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash and redeploy.
errors.unknown: Could not analyze. Try again or enter calories manually.

search.hint: Type at least {min} characters. Results come from Open Food Facts (per 100 g).
search.emptyMessage: Try another name, or switch to Manual and enter macros yourself.
search.incomplete: Incomplete macros — edit manually after selecting
search.applied: Product applied (macros per 100 g). Set how much you ate, then save.
search.appliedIncomplete: Some per-100 g macros are missing. Fill them in, set portion weight, then save.

errors.rateLimited: Too many searches. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: Product search is unavailable. Enter the meal manually.
errors.unknown: Could not search products. Try again or use Manual.

myMeals.title: My Meals
myMeals.subtitle: Edit saved meals, duplicate them, or add one to today.
myMeals.emptyMessage: Add your first manual meal and it will show up here.

fields.name: Name
fields.amountHint: How much you ate. Daily totals scale from the per-100 g values using this weight.
fields.caloriesFromMacrosHint: Calories per 100 g update automatically from protein ×4 + fat ×9 + carbs ×4.
fields.portionSummary: For {amount} g: {calories} kcal · P {protein} · F {fat} · C {carbs}

validation.caloriesRange: Calories per 100 g must be between {min} and {max}
validation.macroRange: Per-100 g value must be between {min} and {max} g

errors.permissionDenied: No access to meals. Check RLS policies.
